items.title: Owners mourn spoiled food after firmware update bricks Samsung smart fridges

items.body: Some Samsung customers in South Korea say a botched firmware update caused their smart refrigerators to stop cooling, leading to food spoilage. Apparently the firmware that handles the "smart" features is in the control loop for basic refrigeration. submitted by /u/GravelySilly [link] [comments]
